model_annotation: The diagram illustrates the percentage of employed individuals in relation to their age, categorized by migration background. The x-axis represents age, spanning from 20 to 70 years in increments of 10, with a linear scale. The y-axis denotes the percentage of employed individuals, ranging from 0% to 100% in increments of 20, also on a linear scale. Four distinct lines are plotted on the graph, each representing a different category: "ohne Migrationshintergrund" (without migration background) in black, "in Deutschland geboren" (born in Germany) in grey, "zugewandert bis 2009" (immigrated until 2009) in light blue, and "zugewandert seit 2010" (immigrated since 2010) in dark blue. The black line starts at approximately 50% at age 20, rises to around 85% between ages 30 and 50, and then declines to nearly 0% at age 70. The grey line follows a similar pattern, beginning at around 45%, peaking between 75% and 80% between ages 30 and 50, and dropping to approximately 0% at age 70. The light blue line commences at about 40%, reaches a peak of roughly 70% between ages 30 and 40, and then decreases to nearly 0% at age 70. The dark blue line starts at approximately 35%, fluctuates between 40% and 65% until age 60, and then sharply declines to around 0% at age 70, with some fluctuations. All lines exhibit a general downward trend after age 55.
